# Menu 230 (reset all morphs) on morph4 of swing600.pmm: it zeroes the morph
# weights only; registering あ afterwards shows the weight it left.
load pmm swing600.pmm
select model morph4
frame 120
select morph 2 あ
morph 2 0.5
save pmm weighted.pmm
reset morphs
save pmm reset.pmm
register morph 2
save pmm registered.pmm
select all morph
save vmd registered.vmd
